On a grey March morning she noticed a green bottle wedged between two rocks, its cork sealed with candle wax. Inside was a single page, written in careful pencil. 'To whoever tends the light: my brother sailed past you in 1974 and never came home. Thank you for the beam that was the last thing he wrote about.' Marta read it twice, then climbed the stairs and sat beside the great lamp. That night she lit it early, and she kept it burning a little brighter, for a stranger she would never meet.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在潮湿的街面上投下长长的光影，红绿灯仍在无人的路口独自变换。远处传来环卫车缓慢的轰鸣，清洁工扫起昨夜遗落的纸屑与落叶。便利店的灯光白得发亮，店员靠着柜台打着哈欠。高楼大多沉睡，只有零星几扇窗亮着，像是不肯睡去的心事。早点铺的蒸笼刚刚升起第一缕白汽，面香混着凉风飘过巷口。天边仍是深蓝，却已隐约透出一线鱼肚白，新的一天正悄悄靠近。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open one, find a smaller doll, and keep opening until you reach the tiniest one.\n- The tiniest doll tells you when to stop, and then you put everything back together on the way out."}
